entities.summary: Jairo Jose Díaz Hernandaz is a Venezuelan former professional baseball pitcher. He made his Major League Baseball (MLB) debut with the Los Angeles Angels of Anaheim in 2014 and also played for the Colorado Rockies from 2015 to 2020, missing 2016 due to Tommy John surgery.
